profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Data Science | Machine Learning | AI Engineer
profile.summary:
Analytical, collaborative software professional with 5+ years of experience along with an intimate
knowledge of product management. Guided entire project initiatives from design to production
deployment. Earned a reputation for troubleshooting issues in real-time as well as identifying solutions
for potential product issues. Possess a strong technical background while also having an innate ability to
communicate non-intuitive concepts in an easily digestible manner.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.insights: Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD), Aurora MySQL and +4 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer - Data Science
positions.insights: Product Development, AWS SageMaker and +15 skills

positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.description:
Job functions aided the Balance Sheet Analytics and Modeling team by:
- Maintaining, running, and developing models for CCAR using econometrics and Statistics. Models are designed to aid in forecasting PPNR.
- Engaging with the Lines of Business to incorporate product feedback into the development process
- Providing support to other BSAM units for expanding their Machine Learning capabilities

positions.title: Junior Quantitative Developer
positions.description:
Job functions help ensure that the Northern Trust Corporation monitors liquidity risk effectively and offers concrete solutions by:
- Using Python to perform data analysis and to construct machine learning algorithms.
- Gathering and analyzing data to calculate the daily Liquidity Coverage and the Net Stable Funding Ratios as well as other early warning and client behavior indicators.
- Helping executives within the company understand daily positions by analyzing data to assemble a daily balance sheet report.
- Providing support to the Stress Testing and Balance Sheet Modeling teams via metric and threshold analysis.
- Automating legacy processes with Python to save the company valuable time. 
- Crafting solutions to answer ad hoc data analysis requests with Python's libraries.

volunteerExperiences.description: I served on the Worship Team playing guitar, drums, and bass.

volunteerExperiences.role: Worship Team Member/Young Adult's Music Director
volunteerExperiences.description: I play multiple instruments to help lead MVC's congregation in worship on Sunday mornings.
